metadata.directionPolicy: For manifestation -> concept, broadMatch means the target concept is broader; narrowMatch means the target concept is narrower.
metadata.reviewPolicy: Discovery mappings do not authorize aggregation; aggregationSafe is false until cohort, denominator, period and diagnostic rules are equivalent.

concepts.label: TB case notification performance
concepts.definition: TB case notification volume or achievement relative to a defined population or programme target.

mappings.rationale: Target achievement is one manifestation of notification performance.
This manifestation combines public and private notification targets.
An annualized population rate is analytically related but not equivalent to target achievement.
This is a Gram Panchayat-specific rate and is narrower than the overall notification-performance concept.

concepts.label: Microbiological confirmation of notified TB
concepts.definition: Notified TB patients with source-defined microbiological confirmation among notified TB patients.

mappings.rationale: The construct aligns, but pooling requires the applicable diagnostic methods, cohort and period.

concepts.label: NAAT as initial TB diagnostic test
concepts.definition: Presumptive TB patients receiving a nucleic-acid amplification test as their initial diagnostic test.

mappings.rationale: The manifestation directly represents the concept, but operational eligibility and referral completion must be verified.

concepts.label: Universal drug-susceptibility testing
concepts.definition: Access to source-appropriate drug-susceptibility testing across the TB diagnostic and resistance pathway.

mappings.rationale: Overall coverage is closest to the concept but depends on the source-defined test bundle and cohort.
Rapid rifampicin testing is one step within the broader UDST pathway.
Rapid isoniazid testing for a restricted resistance subgroup is one step within UDST.
Fluoroquinolone DST among Hr-TB is a restricted step within UDST.
Line-probe testing in MDR/RR-TB is one restricted step within UDST.

concepts.label: TB treatment success and sustained outcome
concepts.definition: Successful TB treatment and source-defined sustained post-treatment outcomes for a treatment cohort.

mappings.rationale: End-of-treatment success is one component of the broader sustained-outcome concept.
This manifestation is restricted to the six-month follow-up point.
This manifestation is restricted to the twelve-month follow-up point.
This manifestation is restricted to the eighteen-month follow-up point.
This manifestation is restricted to the twenty-four-month follow-up point.

concepts.label: TB contact evaluation
concepts.definition: Listed contacts of index TB patients evaluated for TB disease or infection.

mappings.rationale: The construct aligns; implementation requires verification of listed-contact, evaluation and completion rules.

concepts.label: TB preventive treatment coverage
concepts.definition: Eligible people offered or receiving source-defined TB preventive treatment after active TB exclusion.

mappings.rationale: The manifestation is restricted to eligible household contacts younger than five.
The manifestation is restricted to newly enrolled PLHIV eligible for isoniazid preventive treatment.

concepts.label: TB diagnostic network readiness
concepts.definition: Availability, functionality, staffing, transport and capacity utilization of the TB diagnostic network.

mappings.rationale: Operational microscopy facilities are one readiness dimension.
Functional NAAT machines are one technology-readiness dimension.
Laboratory-technician availability is one workforce-readiness dimension.
A functional microscope is one facility-readiness dimension.
Sample transport is one diagnostic-network readiness dimension.
Utilization describes use of available capacity, not readiness alone.
Utilization describes use of available capacity, not readiness alone.
